THE SMILE BEHIND MIA’S PLACE

A place to belong.
A future to build.

Great candy is where we begin. Lasting opportunity is why.

Mia’s Place is inspired by our daughter Mia, who has autism. Our dream is to build a business where people with autism and other disabilities can find meaningful paid work, use their strengths, and feel part of a team.

We want to create a place where employees can build skills, confidence, and a sense of purpose—with support shaped around their individual goals. The long-term aim is reliable employment and greater stability, for employees and their families.

Supporting organizations that help autistic children and their families remains part of our mission. We want that care to extend into opportunities as people grow.

✳

This is the future we’re working toward. Our employment approach and charitable giving plans are still in development.

HOW WE HOPE TO GROW

One mission.
Built in phases.

A strong business can help sustain real opportunities. Our plan is to grow carefully, with input from the people we hope to employ.

  1. 01

    First · Build the foundation

    Start with great candy.

    Launch our sweet and sour gummies and build a business people come back to. Plan future roles with input from people with disabilities and employment specialists.

    The focus: Reliable sales and a practical plan for paid work.

  2. 02

    Next · Start a small pilot

    Open doors to work.

    Begin with a small number of paid roles, accessible training, and individual support. Match work to people’s strengths, interests, and choices, then learn together.

    The focus: Meaningful jobs, shaped by employee feedback.

  3. 03

    Long term · Grow with care

    Make opportunity last.

    Expand employment as the business can sustain it. Work toward dependable schedules, continued support, and room to grow, alongside our charitable giving.

    The focus: Lasting jobs and greater stability for families.

We’re at the beginning. These are planned phases, with timing and scale still to be determined.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

The little
details.

When can I buy Mia’s Place gummies?

We’re still developing the products and planning the launch. Sales aren’t open yet. Launch updates will include availability, pricing, and where to buy.

Will the gummies have less sugar?

That’s our formulation goal, with taste as the priority. Final ingredients, allergen information, nutrition facts, and the sugar comparison will be shared before launch.

What comes in a pouch?

Our planned format is 8–10 gummies in each small sachet, with several sachets inside a resealable outer pouch. The outer-pouch quantity and net weights are still being finalized.

How will purchases support the mission?

Our goal is for candy sales to sustain a business that creates supported, paid employment and contributes to organizations helping autistic children and families. The funding model and giving commitments are still being developed. Before sales begin, we’ll explain how purchases contribute, what supports employment, what goes to charity, and how we’ll report progress.

Are the employment opportunities available now?

The employment program is a future goal; we haven’t launched it yet. We plan to start small, develop roles and support with people with disabilities and employment specialists, and grow as the business can sustain it. We’ll share details when the first opportunities are ready.
